explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/932: for infinitely many r there are at least two n with p_r < n < p_{r+1} all of whose prime factors are < p_{r+1} − p_r. The statement uses 0-indexed Nat.nth Nat.Prime, a shift of r by one that does not affect infiniteness. It counts m in the open interval with maxPrimeFac m < gap, which says all prime factors are below the gap since m ≥ 3. Faithful.
